reader.requirement: At --std 85 a START on an indexed file succeeds only while the file is open INPUT or I-O; when it is not open, or open OUTPUT or EXTEND, the START is unsuccessful with I-O status 47 (IX.1.3.4 logic error), which is not an invalid key condition, so an applicable USE procedure runs and neither INVALID KEY nor NOT INVALID KEY executes.

store attach/arbitration at OPEN only; StartOpenModeGuard reads no edition

reader.notes: IndexedConnector.Start's first line is StartOpenModeGuard (47), before any key logic; EmitInvalid renders INVALID KEY on a 2x class only and NOT INVALID KEY on a 0x class only, so a 47 runs neither, and EmitUseHook dispatches the USE procedure. All four non-open states probed.
